instruction: Configure VS Code to automatically detect and fix all code style violations according to PEP 8 standards when opening a Python file, without using any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in linting or auto-formatting capabilities for Python that can automatically fix PEP 8 violations on file open. This requires extensions like autopep8, black, or pylint.
